summary: War Is Hell is a 1961 American war film written, produced and directed by Burt Topper. It stars Baynes Barron and Michael Bell, with Judy Dan as a featured cast member. The film is narrated by Audie Murphy.
one_line: A 1961 American war film written, produced and directed by Burt Topper, narrated by Audie Murphy.
